decisions.reason: As a core safety shoe line launched only last year, it is close to the firm's established business and a large incumbent would usually tolerate early uncertainty unless clear underperformance appears.

A comfort insole is adjacent to the main footwear business, but because it is only lightly signaled on the website and overlaps with other insole offers, it faces some rationalization risk if results fall below aspiration.
This supportive insole is also close to the core business, yet its overlap with other insole products raises the chance of problemistic search and portfolio pruning if initial sales disappoint.
Its own dedicated page suggests strategic attention and commitment, so with no visible evidence of a shortfall a large established firm would be likely to continue backing it.

Firefighter and rescue boots are a specialized but related niche, and an older German manufacturer would usually keep such a product at least through an initial learning period unless demand clearly misses targets.
Being shown on the home page indicates strong initial support, and with organizational slack and no observed negative signal the firm would likely keep it on the market.
